basic_details.scholarship_name: Nagoya University Global 30 (G30) International Graduate Program MEXT Award
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan & Nagoya University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Nagoya University (Higashiyama Campus, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Graduate School of Engineering, Graduate School of Science, Graduate School of Bioagricultural Sciences, and Graduate School of Environmental Studies (Automotive Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Physics and Mathematics, and Biological and Bioagricultural Sciences).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 60 MEXT University Recommendation scholarships awarded annually under G30 programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 7 to 12 Pakistani engineering and science researchers selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master's; 3 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: JPY 146,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 277,400 / month); JPY 147,000 / month for PhD (~PKR 279,300 / month) plus 100% full tuition waiver and round-trip international airfare

nationality_requirements: Citizens of countries with official diplomatic relations with Japan (Pakistan fully eligible; Japanese dual citizens ineligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be born on or after April 2, 1991 (under 35 years old at commencement per MEXT statutory regulations).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (for Master's) or recognized 18-year Master's degree (for PhD) with minimum MEXT Grade Point Coefficient of 2.30 out of 3.00 from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum MEXT GPA calculation of 2.30 out of 3.00; competitive applicants typically hold MEXT GPA >= 2.65 / 3.00 (equivalent to CGPA >= 3.55 / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Automotive engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, materials science, physics, chemistry, biology, or environmental studies.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing degree requirements before arrival in Japan (late September).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in automotive technology, robotics, physics, or chemistry provide a significant competitive advantage.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate demonstrating CEFR B2 or higher.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese language proficiency is not required.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure inquiry approval and formal consent from a Nagoya University faculty professor before applying.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous MEXT recipients are ineligible unless at least 3 years have elapsed since completing previous award.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full waiver of entrance examination fee (JPY 30,000), admission matriculation fee (JPY 282,000), and annual tuition fees (JPY 535,800/year).

admission_application_fee.details: Screening fee is waived for MEXT scholarship nominees.

accommodation.details: Subsidized international student housing at Nagoya University International Residence (Higashiyama) or Foreign Student House (approx. JPY 22,000 to 40,000 / month), paid from stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free stipend: JPY 146,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 277,400 / month); JPY 147,000 / month for PhD (~PKR 279,300 / month).

airfare.details: Economy-class round-trip international flight ticket between Pakistan and Nagoya Chubu Centrair International Airport fully funded by MEXT.

visa_fee.details: Japanese Student Visa issued free of charge for MEXT government scholars.

health_insurance.details: Enrolled in Japan National Health Insurance (NHI) covering 70% of medical costs; subsidized monthly premium (approx. JPY 2,000/month) paid from stipend.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized dining halls across Higashiyama and Daiko campuses, including halal-friendly dining options.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Nagoya University Kobayashi-Maskawa Institute for the Origin of Particles and the Universe (KMI), Synchrotron Radiation Facility, and university libraries.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory research grants and JSPS project funds cover domestic and international conference participation.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Direct subway access (Nagoya Daigaku Station located directly inside the campus) with student commuter discounts.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite Japanese Imperial University (Nagoya University - Meidai).
participating_institutions: Nagoya University (Higashiyama Campus, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, Japan)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #152 globally, #6 in Japan; home to 6 Nobel Prize laureates (physics & chemistry) and located at the heart of Japan's automotive manufacturing hub (Toyota / Aichi region).
available_majors: Master's / PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering
Master's / PhD in Mechanical Systems Engineering
Master's / PhD in Physics and Applied Physics
Master's / PhD in Chemistry and Materials
Master's / PhD in Biological and Bioagricultural Sciences
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with MEXT GPA >= 2.30/3.00, academic transcripts, research proposal, professor consent letter, two recommendation letters, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 80+ / MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Automotive Engineering and Physics are world-leading and highly competitive; establishing contact with a Nagoya professor during the pre-application inquiry period is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus proposals on intelligent vehicle tech, battery chemistry, or quantum materials, connecting directly to Nagoya's industrial partnerships with Toyota and DENSO.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Nagoya University G30 Online Admissions System & MEXT Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit pre-application inquiry to prospective supervisor, secure faculty consent, register on G30 admissions portal, complete online application, upload documents, and submit.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective academic advisor at Nagoya University via G30 pre-application inquiry (September-November).
Step 2: Obtain formal consent from professor to act as academic supervisor.
Step 3: Complete MEXT University Recommendation application package on the G30 portal (November-January).
Step 4: Graduate School Admissions Committee conducts document screening and video interviews.
Step 5: Nagoya University submits institutional recommendation list to MEXT Tokyo in March.
Step 6: MEXT Tokyo officially ratifies scholarship awards in June.
Step 7: Receive Certificate of Eligibility, obtain Japanese visa, and receive flight tickets.
Step 8: Fly to Nagoya Chubu Airport in late September and start autumn semester on October 1.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Recommendation Track: Admission and MEXT scholarship are evaluated together upon faculty nomination.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by recommenders via confidential portal links or uploaded as signed letters on institutional letterhead.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Program Plan (Kenkyu Keikakusho) detailing background, objectives, experimental methods, and anticipated contributions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured academic proposal following MEXT format detailing problem statement, literature review, experimental methodology, and timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, laboratory techniques, programming skills, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental committee.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translation for all non-English/non-Japanese documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Nagoya University G30 admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: MEXT Application Form for University Recommendation
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Japanese Ministry prescribed application form with applicant photo.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Field of Study and Research Plan (Kenkyu Keikakusho)
required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed research plan following official MEXT template describing proposed research in Japan.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Graduation Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts showing course grades, credits, and grading system for MEXT GPA calculation.
Letters from university dean or department chair and previous academic supervisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On institutional letterhead with official stamps.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Summary of Thesis or Past Research Achievements
required_documents_checklist.specification: Concise 1-2 page summary of Bachelor's or Master's thesis and list of publications.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Summary of final year project or thesis.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Faculty Consent Form / Letter from Nagoya University Professor
required_documents_checklist.specification: Written confirmation from a Nagoya University professor agreeing to supervise the applicant.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly from prospective Nagoya professor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.

important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: March (University nomination to MEXT) / June (MEXT Tokyo final ratification)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for October intake; contact with professors must begin by September-October.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Technical research proposal rigor, previous thesis, supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant scientific laboratory or technical engineering experience)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical interview with prospective Nagoya University faculty advisor)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Nagoya University G30 Admissions Board, School Deans, and Japanese Ministry of Education (MEXT).
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous academic assessment prioritizing candidates with top MEXT GPA coefficients (above 2.65/3.00), strong publication potential, and supervisor backing.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~40 to 60 MEXT University Recommendation awards annually under G30
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~10.0% to 14.0% for candidates with professor consent and MEXT GPA >= 2.65
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: MEXT GPA coefficient >= 2.65 / 3.00 (approx. CGPA >= 3.55 / 4.00), accompanied by strong thesis research or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: STEM graduates with strong laboratory foundations, clear research alignment with Nagoya University research centers, and professor acceptance.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, Quaid-i-Azam, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, COMSATS, PIEAS, GIKI).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, Indonesia, China, Bangladesh, Thailand, Egypt, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only consult official websites at nagoya-u.ac.jp and mext.go.jp.
Beware of unauthorized agents claiming to sell MEXT recommendation seats; MEXT awards are managed strictly by universities.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: No application or examination fee is charged for MEXT scholarship nominees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written proposals are rejected; applicants must author their own Kenkyu Keikakusho.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC document attestation in Pakistan: ~PKR 10,000 to 20,000.
Medical checkup for COE processing: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend deposit: ~JPY 100,000 (~PKR 190,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Japanese language fluency is mandatory. Reality: All G30 graduate programs at Nagoya University are conducted 100% in English.
Myth: You can apply without professor endorsement. Reality: University recommendation track requires prior consent from a Nagoya University faculty professor.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest age limit can be relaxed; MEXT statutory age cutoff (born on or after April 2, 1991) is strictly enforced.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain MEXT Grade Point Coefficient of at least 2.30 out of 3.00 throughout study.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency in Nagoya; monthly signing of scholarship register at university academic office to receive stipend.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress review submitted to MEXT via the Graduate School.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work restricted; requires immigration permission (Shikakugai Katsudo Kyoka) and written consent from academic supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to seek international careers, postdocs in Japan, or return to Pakistan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is immediately terminated if GPA falls below 2.30 or if disciplinary expulsion occurs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly non-transferable under MEXT University Recommendation regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major or laboratory changes are generally not permitted once enrolled.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions from Master's to PhD are highly competitive and require separate MEXT institutional recommendation screening.
